rationale.ai-review: Evaluates reliability of LLM confidence and reflective correctness judgments.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Calibrated confidence supports developers judging generated code.
rationale.quality-debt: Generated completions, repairs, and functions frequently fail correctness checks.
rationale.assistive: Studies line-level completions accepted within human-authored coding workflows.
rationale.agentic: Studies complete function synthesis and artifact-level program repairs.
rationale.metrics: Defines confidence-calibration measures for generated-code quality.
rationale.risk-quality: Reports empirical correctness failures and evaluates calibration-based mitigation.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Calibration targets ill-advised acceptance of confidently incorrect generated code.
rationale.method-experiment: Controlled comparisons characterize third-party models across tasks and datasets.
